Priya: Postmortem follow-up for the 03/20 inference latency spike. Root cause: repeated shard evictions under high-concurrency batches. We need clear owners, Jira links, RACI, and handoff plan.

Marco: I'll own the remediation work to harden eviction heuristics. Created a parent ticket INF-4321.

Tessa: Thanks Marco. Can you add a brief acceptance test so QE can validate?

Marco: Yep — will add INF-4322 (acceptance tests) as a subtask. ETA Wed 2026-03-27.

Jon: SRE will put an alert guardrail in front of the cluster autoscaler to avoid cascading evictions. I'll own INF-4323.

Laura: I'll coordinate the rollout checklist for Dedicated and Private. Need an outreach note for customer success.

eng-sre-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-20260320-01 linked to INF-4321. Pager duty: oncall-sre notified. :clipboard:

Priya: RACI proposal: R=Marco (remediate), A=Priya (postmortem owner), C=Jon,Laura (SRE/Product ops), I=Eng + Support. Agree?

Olaf: Agree. Suggest adding a temporary mitigation: reduce max-concurrency per-GPU by 15% as a canary. I can push config change and monitor.

Marco: Good call. I'll land the heuristic fix behind a feature flag and Olaf can do the canary.

Tessa: QE will validate using the synthetic load harness once Marco lands the flag. Please tag me in INF-4322 when ready.

Ava: For tracking, I've added a follow-up board card: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4321 and a checklist. We should close the parent only after INF-4322 and INF-4323 are done.

Priya: Quick checklist (put in thread so it's visible):
```
- Owner assigned (Marco) - done
- Parent ticket INF-4321 created - done
- Acceptance tests INF-4322 - assigned to Tessa - ETA 2026-03-27
- SRE alert INF-4323 - assigned to Jon - ETA 2026-03-24
- Canary config change - Olaf - immediate
- Rollout plan & customer note - Laura - ETA 2026-03-28
- Post-deploy monitoring window 72h
- Retro follow-up meeting 2026-03-30
```

Jon: Added alert config, brief snippet: `alert: evictions_high_for_5m` -> notify #eng-oncall + escalation. Pushed to staging.

Olaf: Canary config applied to one Dedicated pool. Monitoring now. No regressions after 30m. :eyes:

Marco: Pushed feature-flag branch, linking INF-4321. Will open PR and request reviewers.

Tessa: Once PR merged, I'll run the harness and post results here.

Laura: Drafted customer-facing note for CS; will post in #customer-success for review.

Priya: Follow-up meeting scheduled Mon 2026-03-30 10:00 PT to verify closure criteria. Please update Jira with test logs and rollout outcomes beforehand.

Ava: Marking action items in the remediation board with due dates. I'll ping owners if anything slips.

Marco: If anyone needs me, ping @Marco. Will update INF-4321 with implementation notes and risk assessment.

Jon: Thanks all — nice quick coordination. :thumbsup:

Priya: Closing note: long-term action: analyze recurring eviction pattern across workloads (quarterly spike trend). Marco, can you add an exploratory spike-detection task to backlog?

Marco: Will add INF-4330 (spike-detection analysis) and propose metrics next week.

Priya: Perfect. That's the plan. Meeting invite + Jira links posted.
